ics.title: ICS feed
ics.description: Paste the public or secret iCalendar address (.ics or webcal) of the calendar.

caldav.title: CalDAV server
caldav.description: Enter the address of your CalDAV server. You can use the server root and your calendars will be discovered automatically.

pick.title: Choose a calendar
pick.description: Several calendars were found. Pick one (add the integration again for more).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The server rejected the saved credentials. Enter new ones.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the server or download the calendar.
error.invalid_auth: The server rejected the username or password.
error.invalid_calendar: The data returned could not be read as a calendar.
error.no_calendars: No calendars were found at that address.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

init.title: Live Calendar options
init.description:
**Push URL** (call it to refresh instantly, keep it secret):

`{webhook_url}`

The interval controls how often the source is checked for changes. Checks are cheap when nothing changed.
